subject: CAIQ evidence handoff and assertion intake for Bluefin Payments

From: Anita Rao <anita@bluefinpay.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ request and mapping — Bluefin audit kickoff

Vivek,

Thanks for taking this on. Bluefin is starting a CSA/CAIQ review for our upcoming vendor risk assessment (internal audit window opens 3/21). Attached is our populated CAIQ template (bluefin_caiq_template.xlsx) — we need Redwood's responses mapped to the CSA control IDs and a short artifact list for each assertion. Primary asks:

- CAIQ completed mapping (spreadsheet) for all applicable controls
- Sample artifacts for key controls (KMS rotation, tenant isolation, runtime logs)
- A signed assertion or DocuSign for controls we mark as "customer facing"

Timeline: can you confirm whether 10 business days is reasonable? We can provide scope reductions if needed.

Also copying audit@bluefinpay.com for SOW questions.

Attachments: bluefin_caiq_template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Anita Rao
Head of Vendor Risk, Bluefin Payments
Anita Rao | anita@bluefinpay.com

Forwarding Bluefin's request — see attached CAIQ. Anita wants a completed CAIQ mapping + artifact list and a signed assertion. Please confirm owners and ETA. Specific asks from me: 

- Naomi: owner for runtime evidence (logs, kv/cache sampling, batch traces). Which samples can we commit to within 5 business days?
- Kimberly: owner for cryptography / KMS evidence, key rotation report, and data residency (they may flag EU residency). Also confirm whether we need redaction for tenant IDs.
- I also need a small CSV assertion manifest (one-line per control: control_id, owner, artifact_name, retention_path) we can send to Bluefin and upload to Drive.

Staging: upload artifacts to shared Drive folder and add into the manifest. Naomi/Kimberly, I'll create the folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefGH-bluefin-evidence (private link).

Attachments: bluefin_caiq_template.xlsx (from Bluefin) — forwarding for reference.

Thanks — Vivek
Head of Compliance & Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Vivek/Naomi — I can own the crypto and KMS deliverables. Quick summary and blockers: 

- I’ll provide key_rotation_report_20270303.pdf (export from KMS audit) and a short writeup that maps to controls CCM-KE-01 / CCM-CR-03.
- For tenant isolation controls, confirm whether Bluefin wants full VM-level screenshots or redacted samples. We should push redacted screenshots and a sampling note to avoid exposing tenant metadata.
- I’ll update the evidence_manifest_vivek_20270304.csv with owners for each control and expected artifact names.

I will upload the key rotation report and the manifest to the Drive link and set ACLs to allow view-only to the Bluefin audit account. Expect initial uploads by EOD Fri (5 Mar).

Vivek — this is great, thank you to you and the team for the quick responses. A couple of clarifications from the audit side: 

- The audit team needs a signed assertion for controls that are customer-impacting; can you send a DocuSign link or a scanned signature block once the manifest is ready?
- For runtime logs, obfuscation is fine as long as tenant IDs are consistently masked; please include the masking algorithm in the README.
- We will scope-down the CAIQ to critical controls if needed, but please proceed with the full mapping initially and flag any controls that truly require redaction or legal review.

Attached: Bluefin_Audit_SOW_v1.pdf (contract/SOW)

Can you confirm EOD Friday (5 Mar) for the initial bundle upload? If that slips, give us a short ETA.

Best,
Anita Rao
Head of Vendor Risk, Bluefin Payments
